subject: Kickoff: Mutual Action Plan and evaluation timeline (Acme Analytics)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Mutual Action Plan and evaluation timeline (Acme Analytics)

Hi Aisha —

Great to meet you last week. Per our call, I wanted to put an initial mutual action plan (MAP) on your calendar so we have aligned goals and a clear close timeline for the evaluation. High level from Redwood:

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for production latencies and cost on your 1M-per-month inference workload; confirm integration approach for the Acme analytics platform.
- Desired outcome: Successful 30-day POC with performance and cost report, then decision to move to Dedicated for pilot by mid-September.
- Proposed timeline:
  - MAP kickoff + roles confirmed: this week (Aug 12–15)
  - Technical onboarding / SE sessions: Aug 18–29
  - 30-day POC: Sep 1–Sep 30
  - Executive review & decision: week of Oct 6

I've attached a draft MAP spreadsheet with proposed milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria. Can you confirm: (1) that timeline looks achievable from your side, (2) who will be the primary internal champion and technical owner, and (3) any calendar constraints for a 30–45 minute kickoff this week?

If it helps, I can schedule a slot Thursday at 10am PT — otherwise tell me a time that works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- Acme_MAP_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@acme-analytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 12:03:00 -0400

On Tue, Aug 12, 2025 at 9:15 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Aisha —
> 
> Great to meet you last week. Per our call, I wanted to put an initial mutual action plan (MAP) on your calendar so we have aligned goals and a clear close timeline for the evaluation...

Thanks Vanessa — this looks good and granular, appreciate the concrete milestones. Quick answers:

1) Timeline: we can meet these milestones. Our internal goal is to complete the POC and have an exec decision no later than the first two weeks of October, so your schedule maps well.
2) Champion / owner: I'll act as the program sponsor for the evaluation. Tom Reeves (cc'd) will be the technical owner and will coordinate engineering access. I'll loop in Procurement once we have a final pricing summary.
3) Kickoff time: Thursday 14 Aug at 10am PT works for me and Tom.

A couple of asks up front: can you add a row in the MAP for security review (SOC2 evidence, data retention policy) and include a contact for the Redwood security lead? Also please share the POC acceptance criteria (latency targets, cost thresholds) in the MAP so Procurement can see it when we start approvals.

I'll attach the contact for our security manager and cc procurement in subsequent threads. See contact attached.

Best,
Aisha Malik
Senior Product Manager, Acme Analytics
aisha.malik@acme-analytics.com

Vanessa, we'll make sure an SE (Stephanie) is assigned to run the onboarding sessions and help with the POC acceptance criteria. I've attached a short POC checklist that includes the latency targets we usually baseline for 1M token workloads and an internal list of data-handling FAQs for SOC2.

Aisha — I'll also put in a resource escalation path in the MAP (who to contact for priority infra during the POC).
